tree.heading: Eligibility.—
tree.text: Eligibility for membership in the corporation is as provided in the constitution and bylaws of the corporation.

tree.heading: Voting.—
tree.text: Each active member of a department or chapter has one vote in the conduct of official business of that department or chapter.
